title: Equal probabilities of either returned bit
statement: Let $\rho$ be any real number and let $K$ be a natural number. For $2K$ independent bits, each equal to true with probability $\rho$, the rule that examines consecutive pairs, discards equal pairs, and returns the first bit of the first unequal pair returns true and false with equal probabilities.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ is a real number, with no further restriction
